title: See a show inside the Las Vegas Sphere
description: From your seat inside Sphere, the screen curves overhead and around the audience while sound fills the room. Choose a film, concert, or other production that genuinely interests you, since each uses the venue differently. Give yourself a moment before the show to take in the scale, then let the images change your sense of where the room ends.
teaser: Watch images and sound fill a vast curved theater.
goodToKnow: Shows are seated but can have powerful visual and sound effects. Check the specific production if you are sensitive to motion or sensory intensity.
whyItMightDelightYou: The architecture becomes part of the performance, making even a seated evening feel exploratory.
